jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with your hands and with different materials?

Composite material is made up of multiple materials bonded or laminated together. Think panels, interior parts, and structural aircraft components. As a Composite Shop Worker, you'll repair and maintain these parts. You're comfortable working with a range of materials: composite, plastic, metal, and interior materials. You carry out repairs according to fixed technical specifications and work instructions, working precisely with professional tools in a hangar or workshop environment. You'll also identify and resolve damage to interior and composite components, a role that combines the best of sheet metal work and interior work.

- You have experience working with different materials, or a relevant technical education (e.g. in sheet metal work, composites, or interior construction)
- You have a precise, careful way of working
- You're willing to (further) build your technical expertise
- You speak good English (technical drawings are all in English)
- You're comfortable working with computers; administration is also part of the job
- You're willing to occasionally work evenings and weekends (on average once every 4 weeks - after 8 months from starting)
- Experience in car body repair, automotive interiors, or manufacturing work involving composite/plastic materials is a plus

jobs.occupation: Warehouse Employee at Samsung in Tilburg (121032001)
jobs.description:
The Korean word Samsung translates to "three stars". This reflects to the vision of the founder of the company. A company that is continously growing, improving and will always be a very strong brand. At Samsung SDS we support this vision by assisting Samsung by fullfilling a large part of their supply chain. In our Warehouse in Tilburg, we make sure that different items as tv's, microwaves and vacuumcleaners, washing machines and refridgerators are correctly distributed to their customers. During the day, trucks come in to be unloaded and loaded. The items that come in, need to be checked, put in the right place and prepared for loading. 

Right now, we are looking for:

- Reachtruck drivers to assist in Picking and Putaway
- Forklift and Clamp Drivers to assist loading and unloading
- Warehouse Operators for preparing pallets for transport
- Pickers (please be aware that the items that need to be picked are larger items such as tv's and soundbars)

All this is being done in two shifts. A morning shift from 06.00 to 14.30 and and evening shift from 14.30 to 23.00. You will be working both shifts. It is not possible to work in only one. 

When you are hired as a driver you will also be expected to help with other tasks that need to be done. You will not only be on the forklift of reachtruck.

You enjoy working in an international environment and love to work hard. At Samsung SDS, you'll help keep everything running smoothly in the warehouse.

What you bring:

- You have your own transportation to get to work. Since you'll be working in shifts, public transport is NOT possible!
- You speak and understand English, which is needed in this international environment. This can be tested during the tour!
- You are available full-time and can work both shifts
- You are fit enough for physical work.
- You have your own accommodation. We do NOT provide it!
- You are available for a longer period of time.

It is prefered that you are flexible. Sometimes we work until 1 a.

As a woodworker, you will be working at a modern and stable high-tech company in Eindhoven. You will be responsible on a daily basis for dismantling and reassembling wooden transport crates for large and fragile high-tech components. You will do this based on technical drawings and fixed work instructions.

You will check the quality of the work, identify deviations, and work according to applicable safety regulations. The position is carried out in a two-shift system (06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00) and offers full-time employment with the prospect of a permanent contract.

- Technical insight and experience with woodworking (e.g. machine or manual woodworking, assembly, or production).
- VMBO level of working and thinking.
- Experience in reading technical drawings.
- Ability to work accurately with a strong focus on quality.
- Willingness to work in a two-shift system (06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00).
- Good command of the English language.
- Team player and living in the Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel, or Valkenswaard area.
